description: PS5-style launcher for AnyPS5: finds PS5 game dumps, unlocks them with the AnyPS5 engine and starts them.
notes: Update with 'scoop update anyps5-desktop'. Releases after 0.1.20 see that Scoop installed
them: they say when a new version is out, with that command, and leave the update to Scoop.
0.1.20's own update runs the Windows installer, which puts a second copy in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\AnyPS5 Desktop, so on 0.1.20 turn off Settings -> Behaviour -> Check for updates.
Settings, logs, caches and engines stay in %APPDATA%\AnyPS5 and %LOCALAPPDATA%\AnyPS5.
